reponse: The Q1 payout fee was first proposed at 0.40% per payout (minimum $0.25) with volume tiers [1][3], but after Gil's review it was set to 0.45%, making the v3 proposal outdated — tiers unchanged, with customer notices due by Dec 1 [2]. One rep mistakenly quoted Pinecrest 0.40% and plans to correct it [2]. The 0.40% figures in the proposal and draft email are therefore superseded by the more recent 0.45% decision [2].
